comment: The Haro v0.12 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.12 grows v0.11 by the charter's section 3 row `FORMS inside a vocabulary` -- principle 7's function-name grammar declared as data: FORMS, at most one per language, with FLUENT (the suffix that returns the receiver), PASSIVE (the inflection of the form that may not mutate), STATEMENT (the assertion suffix), PARAMS (the parameter suffixes, key: suffix) and FAMILY (the declaration kind that spells a family, its base seat and its offered-forms seat). One meaning per suffix (R1, R2: the FF clash of the forms document); a suffix is letters (R5); a FAMILY names a declared kind with a scalar base seat and a list forms seat (R3, R6); at most one FORMS (R4). Every v0.11 fixture still passes: v0.12 refuses nothing v0.11 accepted (A2 is v0.11's A1).

accepts.name: a FORMS with the three forms, the parameter suffixes and the FAMILY declaration
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE stzv AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".stzv") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU offered AS (WORDS [cs, st, xt, many, fluent, passive]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION family AS (VERB "FAMILY", SEATS [base: text, forms: [offered]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS stz AS (FLUENT "Q", PASSIVE "ed", STATEMENT "X", PARAMS [cs: "CS", st: "ST", xt: "XT", many: "Many"], FAMILY [family, base, forms]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.11 declaration is a v0.12 declaration: v0.11's A1, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU outcomes AS (WORDS [success, refused], CODE "PARSE") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: outcomes]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION node AS (OF [step, terminal], CODE "C5") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", REF "calls", CODE "UNRESOLVED_FLOW", CITES ["article:placement-3.2"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_ending AS (ON terminal, WHEN "outcome absent", MESSAGE "x", CODE "C7") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_declaration AS (MESSAGE "the declaration set is closed", CODE "PARSE") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a FORMS of parameter suffixes alone: no fluent, no passive, no statement, no family
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (PARAMS [cs: "CS"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: one meaning per suffix: two parameter forms spelt FF (the forms document's own clash)
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (PARAMS [future: "FF", free: "FF"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'FF' is spelt twice, as future and as free: one meaning per suffix

rejects.name: one meaning per suffix: the fluent form and a parameter form spelt the same
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (FLUENT "Q", PARAMS [q: "Q"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'Q' is spelt twice, as FLUENT and as q: one meaning per suffix

rejects.name: FAMILY names a seat the kind lacks
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION family AS (VERB "FAMILY", SEATS [base: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (PARAMS [cs: "CS"], FAMILY [family, base, forms]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: at most one FORMS per language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS one AS (PARAMS [cs: "CS"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS two AS (PARAMS [st: "ST"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a .haro file declares at most one FORMS

rejects.name: a suffix is letters
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (PARAMS [cs: "C S"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: is not a suffix: a suffix is letters

rejects.name: FAMILY's forms seat is a list
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU offered AS (WORDS [cs]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION family AS (VERB "FAMILY", SEATS [base: text, forms: offered]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (PARAMS [cs: "CS"], FAMILY [family, base, forms]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: the forms seat 'forms' of family is a list of the forms offered

rejects.name: a parameter key may not take the fluent role's own word
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE v AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".v") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS v AS (FLUENT "Q", PARAMS [fluent: "F"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: PARAMS: 'fluent' is the FLUENT role's own word
